territories.name: Fiji
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Fiji levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act 1991: the Fiji Revenue and Customs Service sets the rate at 12.5 per cent from 1 August 2025, the Second Schedule zero-rates exports and the other supplies it lists, the First Schedule exempts the supplies it lists, and a registered person files a monthly, quarterly or annual return with the Service.
